title: This is Sten. – The Morning Rush (60 s)

cta.question: Every site has a Sten. Give yours *LUPNUMBER*.
cta.label: Book a demo

beats.en: Sten works at a very busy logistics site. Every morning, thirty trucks arrive.
cues: Sten works at a very busy / logistics site.

beats.en: Usually at the same time. Sten loves that.
Sten also speaks thirty languages. Well. According to management.
Management needs the numbers by nine. Sten finds this very relaxing.
cues: Management needs the numbers by nine.

beats.en: Safety is also Sten. Here he is, explaining the rules. In Swedish. To Dariusz.
cues: Here he is, explaining the rules.

beats.en: And now: ten more trucks. It is seven-oh-one.
There is another way to run a gate.
cues: There is another way / to run a gate.

beats.en: Drivers check in on their own phones. In their own language. Twenty-six real ones.
cues: Drivers check in on their own phones.

beats.scene: Dock, instructions, safety. Before the barrier.
beats.en: Dock, instructions, safety rules. Before the barrier.
The site sees every vehicle. The numbers write themselves.
Sten still works at a very busy site. He just doesn't have to be thirty people.
cues: Sten still works / at a very busy site.
He just doesn't have to be / thirty people.

beats.en: This is Sten. He's fine now.
